title: DishwasherBench – Can Frontier Models Stack a Dishwasher?
script:
Composo AI just released DishwasherBench to measure how well frontier models stack a dishwasher.
This benchmark uses a digital simulation to test spatial reasoning for common kitchen chores.
The framework specifically evaluates how models handle 3D objects in a confined environment.
It requires models to place items like plates and cups without collisions.
Researchers can access the full evaluation suite and environment code on GitHub right now.
These tests aim to advance how AI models perceive everyday physical spaces.
Would you trust your expensive dishes to an AI?
